reason: Retrospective operational-rule revision after seven missing bid/ask observations were confirmed. This is a different strategy, not a repaired dataset or an out-of-sample result.
trigger: At each regular hourly observation after entry (10:00 through 16:00 America/New_York), buy back at observed ASK when ASK <= 0.50 * original short-sale BID, before fees. No same-week reentry.
other_rules: Original entry, strike selection, daily ITM risk close, Friday 15:00 mandatory close and October 2 15:00 final liquidation unchanged.
data_rule: No synthetic/forward-filled prices. If an open position lacks a required quote, retain the missing observation or halt as required; do not claim zero gaps until audited.
selection_disclosure: One threshold chosen as a simple risk-management rule before computing revised performance; no return-driven parameter search. Earlier data-gap knowledge influenced design.
